_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30, but the sell-side read for ACN was share gain (J.P.Morgan, 2023-02-10) and the stock trades at 24.3x FY23E — near its own median, not an AI discount. Re-file under DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (GENAI) only when the multiple starts discounting the legacy-services deflation J.P.Morgan describes, or it shows up in managed-services growth.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.91x; +35% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.08; conservative 2yr +3%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY12-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (FY12-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-04-28) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.91x (27.9% downside to Bear $202 / +30.6% upside to Bull $366) | Adj composite 3.06 vs market 2.98: gap +0.08 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +35% above the EPP floor $207 (18x FY23E $11.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: +2.6% total (+1.3%/yr) | At 24.3x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $371 sits above the BULL case; consulting +4% LC in Q2, Q3 guided +3-7% LC; GenAI is a live theme, read by the sell side as share gain for consultancies, not a threat.
